brief.regime: Indian equities saw sharp selling as the Nifty dropped 1.75% to 25,350 and India VIX climbed 2.18% to 17.70, reflecting weak market breadth with 1,327 declines against 473 advances. IT (+1.69%) and Realty (+0.31%) held up as leading sectors, while Metal (-3.68%) and PSU Banking (-3.25%) heavily dragged the market. Macro pressures were mixed as Brent crude fell 4.40% to $88.50 and US 10-year yields slipped to 4.91%, while the Indian Rupee strengthened past 93 per USD backed by over $12 billion in foreign equity inflows.
